NVDA.name: NVIDIA Corporation
NVDA.ai_strategy_one_line_zh: 以CUDA平台和全栈协同设计打造数据中心级AI基础设施
NVDA.ai_strategy_one_line_en: Data center-scale AI infrastructure with CUDA platform and extreme co-design

MSFT.name: Microsoft Corporation
MSFT.ai_strategy_one_line_zh: 以微软云为底座，将AI贯穿全技术栈，通过Copilot与智能体普及负责任的企业级AI生产力。
MSFT.ai_strategy_one_line_en: Embed responsible AI across the Microsoft Cloud stack, driving enterprise productivity through Copilot and agents.

PLTR.name: Palantir Technologies Inc.
PLTR.ai_strategy_one_line_zh: 通过AIP平台将生成式AI安全集成到政府与企业决策中，实现责任AI优势。
PLTR.ai_strategy_one_line_en: Leverage AIP platform to integrate generative AI securely into government and enterprise decisions for responsible AI advantage.

META.name: Meta Platforms, Inc.
META.ai_strategy_one_line_zh: 以AI驱动全系应用体验，自研基础模型与AI助手，并延伸至AI眼镜等硬件。
META.ai_strategy_one_line_en: Uses AI to power apps and ranking, builds Meta AI assistant, and extends AI into glasses and VR.
concrete_bets: Meta AI assistant across apps and AI glasses
AI-powered content ranking and discovery engine
Ray-Ban Meta and Oakley Meta AI glasses

themes.evidence_one_line_zh: 围绕智能体劫持风险、企业训练数据合成、来源验证、计算机使用与工具使用数据集生成等编排与基础设施话题。
themes.evidence_one_line_en: Covers agent hijacking risks, enterprise training data synthesis, source-aware verification, computer-use agents and tool-use dataset generation.

themes.evidence_one_line_zh: 聚焦GPU替代内核优化、推理瓶颈加速、视觉语言模型加速、推理努力控制与长程交互信念更新等效率议题。
themes.evidence_one_line_en: Focuses on kernel optimization for Apple Silicon, inference bottleneck acceleration, VLMs, reasoning effort control and long-horizon interaction efficiency.

themes.evidence_one_line_zh: 包含默认预算上限、代理蠕虫攻击、面部模糊与元数据清除、文本水印检测、AI文本检测及模型蒸馏防御等安全议题。
themes.evidence_one_line_en: Covers budget caps, agent worm attacks, face blurring, watermarking detection, AI text detection and model-distillation defense.

themes.evidence_one_line_zh: 展示GPT-6模型选型、报告生成模型开源以及金融、零售、服务业与小企业采用生成式AI的落地案例。
themes.evidence_one_line_en: Showcases GPT-6 model selection, open-sourced report generation and generative AI adoption in finance, retail, services and small business.

themes.evidence_one_line_zh: 涵盖循环Transformer隐藏推理、多语言语音合成评测、扩散控制器图像生成、长视频生成、教学互动生成与基因组预测迁移学习。
themes.evidence_one_line_en: Covers looped transformer hidden reasoning, TTS multilingual evaluation, diffusion image generation, long-form video, teaching interactives and genomic transfer learning.

alias.notes: Proposed one new canonical for 'Enterprise AI Platform' as it represents a distinct platform/topic not covered by the known canonical list. All other raw themes mapped to existing canonicals, with trivial variants (e.g., 'Agents', 'AI系统可观测性', 'Token/成本可观测', 'Prompt injection/AI安全', '企业数据上的应用LLM', AI编码agent variants) normalized to their closest known canonical.
